name: ADA Solar RGB
description: ADA's flagship suspended RGB pendant: 160 RGB LEDs tuned for plant coloration, the reference light of Nature Aquarium gallery layouts. ADA publishes a 3,000-3,500 lm luminous-flux range; light.lumens records the conservative low bound (3000). ADA publishes a 9,000-12,000K colour-temperature range (with unit-to-unit variation); light.colorTempK records the mid-point (10500). light.fixtureLengthMm is the published 430 mm unit width; beam angle is not published and is omitted. coverageLitres approximates ADA's 60-90 cm tank recommendation using the 60-P (64 L) and 90-P (182 L) volumes; ADA otherwise publishes PAR/illuminance (~21,000 lx at 30 cm) rather than retail-style coverage.
